submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on a learned set of mid-sentence content tokens, typically a concrete or topical noun (telescope, valley, report, cat, summit, charges, capital), a code operand or closing token (3, a, ):, html), or the completion piece of a split word (phony, let, tons), when the token completes a tight licensing local frame such as a determiner or quantifier plus noun (The/the/a/all), an open call paren, or a word prefix. The same frame with an off-set noun (microscope, rumor, notion) sharply reduces or abolishes firing, and the same noun without its licenser or at sentence-initial position fires weakly or not at all, so activity is the conjunction of token membership and licensing context, not either alone.
